k1.text: Deir ez-Zor, Syria — the Euphrates deconfliction line, February 7, 2018

k2.text: Conoco gas plant — US special operators and SDF fighters hold the facility

k3.text: A Wagner column — T-72s, T-55s, BMPs, ~500 men — rolls out of Khasham toward the plant

k4.text: Wagner howitzers and Grad rockets open fire on the defenders

k5.text: US aircraft respond — F-15Es, an MQ-9, an AC-130 gunship, Apaches

k6.text: Precision strikes walk down the column, vehicle by vehicle

k7.text: A B-52 arrives to finish the survivors on the road

k8.text: HIMARS counter-battery fire silences the Wagner artillery

k9.text: By dawn the column is destroyed — no US casualties
